0022600230.text: The Phoenix Suns (4-6, 11th in the West) host the Charlotte Hornets (4-7, 9th in the East) in the Suns' 11th game of the season, with Phoenix 4-3 at home and 0-3 on the road while Charlotte is 1-3 away from home and 3-7 over its last ten. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix after shoulder surgery, while Charlotte is without Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate is day-to-day with a quadriceps injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with Charlotte winning the most recent meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
